title.en: A Stop on the Bare Rock
title.fr: Une halte sur la roche nue

summary.en: This place has something to tell you, and so do the two stops further along the rock. Read at each one, then answer the questions it leaves you about who Canadians are.
summary.fr: Ce lieu a quelque chose à vous apprendre, et les deux haltes plus loin sur la roche aussi. Lisez à chacune, puis répondez aux questions qu'elle vous laisse sur qui sont les Canadiens.

text.en: This place is not going anywhere. Come back whenever you like.
text.fr: Ce lieu ne bouge pas d'ici. Revenez quand vous voudrez.

text.en: Each stop along the bare rock teaches you something about this country. Your task on the screen says what to do now.
text.fr: Chaque halte sur la roche nue vous apprend quelque chose sur ce pays. Votre mission à l'écran indique ce qu'il faut faire maintenant.

text.en: Across Canada, people of many backgrounds and many faiths live and work peacefully side by side, proud to be Canadians.
text.fr: Partout au Canada, des personnes d'origines et de croyances diverses vivent et travaillent paisiblement côte à côte, fières d'être canadiennes.

source.quote: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians.

verification.evidence: Many ethnic and religious groups live and work in peace as proud Canadians.

text.en: You made your stop at the light on the bare rock, then walked on to the fish store and the village house. Three stops, and your walk here is over.
text.fr: Vous avez fait halte au phare sur la roche nue, puis vous avez continué jusqu'au hangar de pêche et à la maison du village. Trois haltes, et votre marche ici est terminée.

text.en: You have reached the light on the bare rock. Two things about this country come first, then five questions.
text.fr: Vous voici au phare, sur la roche nue. D'abord deux choses sur ce pays, puis cinq questions.

text.en: Canada has two official languages, English and French. The law says the federal government must serve you in either one, anywhere in the country.
text.fr: Le Canada a deux langues officielles, l'anglais et le français. La loi oblige le gouvernement fédéral à vous servir dans l'une ou l'autre, partout au pays.

source.quote: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people and are the country’s official languages. The federal government is required by law to provide services throughout Canada in English and French.

verification.evidence: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people and are the country’s official languages. The federal government is required by law to provide services throughout Canada in English and French.

text.en: Just one province has both of them as its own official languages. That province is New Brunswick.
text.fr: Une seule province a les deux comme langues officielles. Cette province, c'est le Nouveau-Brunswick.

source.quote: New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province.

verification.evidence: While the majority of Francophones live in the province of Quebec, one million Francophones live in Ontario, New Brunswick and Manitoba, with a smaller presence in other provinces. New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province.

text.en: Five questions about that come next. After them, keep walking: there are two more stops along the rock, and each has something of its own.
text.fr: Cinq questions là-dessus viennent ensuite. Après, continuez à marcher : il y a deux autres haltes sur la roche, chacune avec sa propre matière.

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about English and French in Canada
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur l'anglais et le français au Canada

prompt.en: Walk on to the fish store

text.en: Nothing about this ground is easy. Work was got out of it anyway.
text.fr: Rien n'est facile sur ce sol. On en a tout de même tiré du travail.

text.en: A belief in ordered freedom, in enterprise, in hard work and in fair play built a well-off country out of rough ground, from this ocean west to the Pacific and north to the Arctic.
text.fr: Une foi dans la liberté ordonnée, dans l'esprit d'entreprise, dans le travail acharné et dans le franc-jeu a bâti un pays prospère sur un sol difficile, de cet océan jusqu'au Pacifique à l'ouest et jusqu'à l'Arctique au nord.

source.quote: A belief in ordered liberty, enterprise, hard work and fair play have enabled Canadians to build a prosperous society in a rugged environment from our Atlantic shores to the Pacific Ocean and to the Arctic Circle

verification.evidence: A belief in ordered liberty, enterprise, hard work and fair play have enabled Canadians to build a prosperous society in a rugged environment from our Atlantic shores to the Pacific Ocean and to the Arctic Circle—so much so that poets and songwriters have hailed Canada as the “Great Dominion.”

prompt.en: Stop and read at the fish store
prompt.fr: Arrêtez-vous pour lire au hangar de pêche

prompt.en: Answer 5 questions about the peoples who built Canada
prompt.fr: Répondez à 5 questions sur les peuples qui ont bâti le Canada

prompt.en: Walk on to the village house
prompt.fr: Continuez jusqu'à la maison du village

text.en: A house is where a life gets built. The last thing here is about the life you are starting.
text.fr: Une maison, c'est là qu'une vie se bâtit. La dernière chose ici porte sur la vie que vous commencez.

text.en: Whoever arrives here to become Canadian is expected to take up this country's democratic principles. The rule of law is the example given.
text.fr: On s'attend à ce que quiconque arrive ici pour devenir canadien adopte les principes démocratiques du pays. La primauté du droit est l'exemple donné.

source.quote: In becoming Canadian, newcomers are expected to embrace democratic principles such as the rule of law.

verification.evidence: Such experiences do not justify bringing to Canada violent, extreme or hateful prejudices. In becoming Canadian, newcomers are expected to embrace democratic principles such as the rule of law. … Canada’s legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.

prompt.en: Stop and read at the village house
prompt.fr: Arrêtez-vous pour lire à la maison du village

prompt.en: Answer 3 questions about what Canadians share
prompt.fr: Répondez à 3 questions sur ce que les Canadiens partagent
